openGaps.title: 6 artifact workflows were FAILED
openGaps.finding: aegis, carlota-jo, command, pulse, terra, vessels workflows were not running. Root cause: localPort mismatch with shared proxy port 9090.
openGaps.resolution: Set localPort=9090 in artifact.toml for aegis, carlota-jo, terra. Command/pulse/vessels were already correct or fixed in prior sessions.
